stem:
During Diwali, Meera observes four different changes happening at home and notes them in her notebook.

She remembers that combustion is a reaction in which a substance reacts with oxygen and produces heat or light.

Which of the changes Meera observed is combustion?

options.text: An electric bulb glowing and giving out heat when switched on
A piece of camphor burning in air with a flame during aarti
Wax melting near a hot diya and becoming soft
Water in a pan boiling and giving off steam on the stove

teacher.key_rationale: Combustion requires BOTH reaction with oxygen AND production of heat or light. Only camphor burning in air (B) involves a substance reacting with oxygen and producing heat and light. A produces heat and light but involves no chemical reaction with oxygen; C and D are physical changes (melting, boiling) with no oxygen reaction. A is the trap for students who check only the heat/light condition and drop the oxygen condition.
